Find match candidates for merger recipients

Source: R/matching.R
match_candidates.Rd

For each treated unit (a merger recipient in its merger year), returns every pool organization-year in the same NTEE group whose baseline size and financial condition fall within the calipers, ranked by a standardized distance. Calendar years need not coincide: a 2015 merger can be matched to a 2019 comparison year. Dollar measures are in constant dollars, and sizes are compared in logs.

Usage

match_candidates(
  treated,
  pool,
  ntee_chars = 2L,
  size = c("REAL_ASSETS", "REAL_EXPENSES"),
  health = "MARGIN",
  size_caliper = log(2),
  health_caliper = c(MARGIN = 0.1, EQUITY_RATIO = 0.15, MONTHS_CASH = 3),
  max_year_gap = Inf
)

Arguments

treated

treated element of merger_sample().

pool

Output of match_pool().

ntee_chars

NTEE characters that must agree (2 = letter and first digit, e.g. "E2"; 3 = full code).

size

Size measures (constant-dollar columns), compared as log1p.

health

Profitability or fiscal-health measures: any of "MARGIN", "EQUITY_RATIO", "MONTHS_CASH".

size_caliper

Maximum absolute difference in log size (for each size measure); log(2) allows up to a factor of two.

health_caliper

Maximum absolute difference for each health measure (named numeric, or one value for all).

max_year_gap

Optional maximum |YEAR - C_YEAR|.

Value

A data.table, one row per treated unit and candidate: T_ID, T_EIN2, T_YEAR, C_EIN2, C_YEAR, YEAR_GAP, SAME_SUBSECTION, the differences (D_*), DIST (root mean square of differences scaled by the pool's standard deviations), and RANK (1 = closest).
